connector.name: Tako
connector.registryDescription: Give your agent web search and authoritative datasets: S&P Global, FRED, OECD, SimilarWeb & more.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.tako.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the takodata account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Tako API token as a Bearer credential, e.g. `Bearer <token>` (CLI/desktop hosts such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf). Get one at tako.com -> account settings -> API tokens. Web hosts (Claude.ai, ChatGPT) use the server's OAuth flow instead, so this header is optional.
